# limen_caller (Data Source)

Who the provider is logged in as, and what it may write: for a bot writer, its `policy_writer` grant. Useful in checks and preconditions, so a run explains a refusal before it sends a write.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "limen_caller" "me" {}

# Fail early, with a clear message, when the bot's grant doesn't cover the
# profile this module needs.
resource "terraform_data" "grant_check" {
  lifecycle {
    precondition {
      condition     = contains(data.limen_caller.me.grant.profiles, "payments-postgres")
      error_message = "${data.limen_caller.me.principal} may not complete the payments-postgres profile."
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `admin` (Boolean) True for a person with `limen:admin`.
- `expires_at` (String) When the provider's credentials expire (RFC 3339).
- `grant` (Attributes) The bot's grant; null for a person. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grant))
- `policy_version` (Number) The active policy version.
- `principal` (String) A person's name, or `bot:<name>`.
- `server_version` (String) The control plane's version.

<a id="nestedatt--grant"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grant`

Read-Only:

- `approver_groups` (List of String) IdP groups whose members may approve its held changes, besides admins.
- `document_count` (Number) How many it owns now.
- `kinds` (List of String) The kinds it may write.
- `max_documents` (Number) The most documents it may own.
- `name` (String) The `policy_writer` document's name.
- `name_patterns` (List of String) Patterns every name it writes must match, such as `payments-*`.
- `namespace` (String) The one namespace it writes in.
- `profiles` (List of String) The profiles its resources may complete.
